title: Term Loan Credit Agreement (synthetic)
section_7_1: Net Leverage Ratio as of the last day of any fiscal quarter shall not exceed 3.00 to 1.00.

definitions.Adjusted EBITDA: Net income before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization, and foreign exchange gains and losses, for the four fiscal quarters then ended.

correction_clause: If any financial statements delivered are materially misstated, the Borrower shall promptly deliver corrected financial statements and a corrected Compliance Certificate.
